@randomstuff tagging you in based on your suggestion here: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/2280#issuecomment-2461643860

I originally planned to cover it in #2231, but @tghosth proposed this section is a better fit.

comments.body: Is this definitely deduplicated against 5.4.1 and 5.4.3?

@tghosth yep! 5.4.1 is about memory safe strings and string functions (`std::string` and `strncpy_s` etc.) and also pointer arithmetic, which is a bit overloaded of a requirement IMHO. 5.4.3 is more concerned with numeric types and using the proper operators to get sensible results. I propose use-after-free is a net new vuln with its own remediation requirement (avoiding dangling pointers).
ok so open a PR please :)
